1,0,1: George Berrington reviewed with Chris and Leanne where new work comes from. Almost all leads are referrals from operating partners, with very little outbound. We agreed a targeted outbound programme to operating partners at mid-market PE houses and a small events plan.
5,1,1: Tighten the sales process from first meeting to signed engagement letter.
5,2,1: Chris to bring the last five proposals, won and lost.
2,1,1: Leanne's data showed 31 qualified opportunities in 12 months, 24 of them from the three core PE houses or partner referrals. Website inbound was almost nil.
2,2,1: Chris was reluctant to cold contact operating partners, worried it looks junior. Agreed outbound should be partner-to-partner and insight led, not SDR style.
2,3,1: Meridian has sponsored a regional manufacturing awards night for three years with no traceable work. Leanne thinks a small operating partner roundtable would do better.
3,2,1: Chris and two senior partners each contact 10 operating partners per month at mid-market PE houses, with a short note on a relevant sector insight.
3,4,1: Replace the manufacturing awards sponsorship with two operating partner roundtables a year in Birmingham, capped at 12 guests.
3,5,1: Use a 4-touch sequence over 6 weeks: insight note, LinkedIn connection, roundtable invite, follow-up call.
3,3,1: Rebuild the website around the PE value-creation proposition before spending on any paid search.
